is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles sinensis mosquitoes (Page 1, Abstract; Page 2, 'Methods').

reports_target_markers.evidence: Reports para-type sodium channel gene mutations at codon 1014: L1014F and L1014S (Page 1, Abstract; Page 5, 'Kdr allele frequency distribution').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Figure 1 shows pie charts of allele frequencies per site, but numerical genotype counts (RR/RS/SS) or exact allele counts per population are not provided in the main text (reported partly in supplementary files, e.g., Table S2 mentions haplotypes).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected exclusively in China across 15 localities in central, south, and southwest China (Page 2, 'Sample collection and preparation'; Table 1). No African populations were surveyed.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article presenting novel field collections and molecular analysis (Page 2, 'Methods').

sub_country_location.evidence: Table 1 provides specific localities and geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) for 15 sites across China.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection dates in Table 1 span from July 2007 (YNNE) to August 2012 (SDHZ), covering a range of >5 years.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Original field collections across China described by the authors.

supplement.evidence: The study is fundamentally ineligible due to non-African field populations.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the evolutionary genetics and spatial population structure of kdr mutations (L1014F, L1014S, and L1014C) in Anopheles sinensis collected across 15 localities in China.
